{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent (MVar, newMVar, readMVar, modifyMVar_, forkIO, threadDelay)
import Control.Concurrent.STM (TVar, newTVarIO, readTVarIO, atomically, writeTVar)
import Control.Exception (bracket, finally, SomeException, catch)
import Control.Monad (when, unless, forever, void)
import Data.IORef (IORef, newIORef, readIORef, writeIORef, atomicModifyIORef')
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isSuffixOf)
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime)
import System.Directory (listDirectory, doesDirectoryExist, doesFileExist, getPermissions, readable)
import System.FilePath ((</>), takeDirectory, normalise, makeRelative, splitDirectories)
import System.IO (hFlush, stdout, hSetBuffering, BufferMode(..), Handle, openFile, IOMode(..), hClose, hPutStrLn)
import System.Posix.Signals (installHandler, Handler(..), sigTERM, sigINT)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map

data AgentConfig = AgentConfig
  { logBaseDir    :: FilePath
  , monitorDirs   :: [FilePath]
  , statusPort    :: Int
  , maxDepth      :: Int
  , allowedExts   :: [String]
  }

data AgentState = AgentState
  { isShuttingDown :: TVar Bool
  , activeScans   :: MVar (Map.Map FilePath UTCTime)
  , logHandle     :: MVar Handle
  , scanResults   :: IORef [FilePath]
  }

defaultConfig :: AgentConfig
defaultConfig = AgentConfig
  { logBaseDir  = "/var/log/agent"
  , monitorDirs = ["/var/log/agent/metrics", "/var/log/agent/events"]
  , statusPort  = 9100
  , maxDepth    = 3
  , allowedExts = [".log", ".json", ".csv"]
  }

initState :: AgentConfig -> IO AgentState
initState cfg = do
  shutdown <- newTVarIO False
  scans    <- newMVar Map.empty
  results  <- newIORef []
  h        <- openFile (logBaseDir cfg </> "agent.log") AppendMode
  hSetBuffering h LineBuffering
  logH     <- newMVar h
  return $ AgentState shutdown scans logH results

installShutdownHandlers :: AgentState -> IO ()
installShutdownHandlers state = do
  let handler = Catch $ do
        atomically $ writeTVar (isShuttingDown state) True
        drainAndFlush state
  void $ installHandler sigTERM handler Nothing
  void $ installHandler sigINT handler Nothing

drainAndFlush :: AgentState -> IO ()
drainAndFlush state = do
  scans <- readMVar (activeScans state)
  unless (Map.null scans) $ do
    threadDelay 100000
    drainAndFlush state

logMessage :: AgentState -> String -> IO ()
logMessage state msg = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let entry = show now ++ " [AGENT] " ++ msg
  h <- readMVar (logHandle state)
  hPutStrLn h entry `catch` (\(_ :: SomeException) -> return ())

-- Path validation: ensures requested path stays within allowed boundaries
validatePath :: AgentConfig -> FilePath -> Bool
validatePath cfg requestedPath =
  let normalized = normalise requestedPath
      components = splitDirectories normalized
      noTraversal = not (".." `elem` components)
      withinBase = any (\base -> isPrefixOf (normalise base) normalized) (monitorDirs cfg)
  in noTraversal && withinBase

-- Core directory enumeration for monitoring
scanDirectory :: AgentConfig -> AgentState -> FilePath -> Int -> IO [FilePath]
scanDirectory cfg state dir depth = do
  shutting <- readTVarIO (isShuttingDown state)
  if shutting || depth > maxDepth cfg
    then return []
    else do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      modifyMVar_ (activeScans state) (return . Map.insert dir now)
      exists <- doesDirectoryExist dir
      if not exists
        then do
          modifyMVar_ (activeScans state) (return . Map.delete dir)
          return []
        else do
          entries <- listDirectory dir `catch` (\(_ :: SomeException) -> return [])
          results <- mapM (processEntry cfg state dir depth) entries
          modifyMVar_ (activeScans state) (return . Map.delete dir)
          return (concat results)

processEntry :: AgentConfig -> AgentState -> FilePath -> Int -> FilePath -> IO [FilePath]
processEntry cfg state parentDir depth entry = do
  let fullPath = parentDir </> entry
  isDir <- doesDirectoryExist fullPath
  if isDir
    then scanDirectory cfg state fullPath (depth + 1)
    else do
      isFile <- doesFileExist fullPath
      if isFile && hasAllowedExtension cfg entry
        then return [fullPath]
        else return []

hasAllowedExtension :: AgentConfig -> FilePath -> Bool
hasAllowedExtension cfg name = any (`isSuffixOf` name) (allowedExts cfg)

-- Status endpoint handler - returns scan results for monitoring dashboard
handleStatusRequest :: AgentConfig -> AgentState -> FilePath -> IO (Either String [FilePath])
handleStatusRequest cfg state requestedDir = do
  shutting <- readTVarIO (isShuttingDown state)
  when shutting $ logMessage state "Status request during shutdown"
  let safeDir = sanitizeForStatus cfg requestedDir
  case safeDir of
    Nothing  -> return $ Left "Access denied: path outside monitored directories"
    Just dir -> do
      results <- scanDirectory cfg state dir 0
      atomicModifyIORef' (scanResults state) (\old -> (results ++ old, ()))
      return $ Right results

-- Sanitization for status endpoint paths
sanitizeForStatus :: AgentConfig -> FilePath -> Maybe FilePath
sanitizeForStatus cfg path =
  let cleaned = normalise path
      isValid = validatePath cfg cleaned
  in if isValid then Just cleaned else Nothing

-- Periodic scan loop
runPeriodicScan :: AgentConfig -> AgentState -> IO ()
runPeriodicScan cfg state = do
  shutting <- readTVarIO (isShuttingDown state)
  unless shutting $ do
    mapM_ (\dir -> scanDirectory cfg state dir 0) (monitorDirs cfg)
    threadDelay 30000000
    runPeriodicScan cfg state

-- External query interface - used by dashboard API
-- During graceful shutdown, serves denial message
queryDirectoryListing :: AgentConfig -> AgentState -> String -> IO (Either String [FilePath])
queryDirectoryListing cfg state rawPath = do
  shutting <- readTVarIO (isShuttingDown state)
  if shutting
    then do
      logMessage state $ "Rejecting request during shutdown for: " ++ rawPath
      return $ Left "Service shutting down, request denied"
    else handleStatusRequest cfg state rawPath

main :: IO ()
main = do
  let cfg = defaultConfig
  state <- initState cfg
  installShutdownHandlers state
  logMessage state "Agent starting"
  void $ forkIO $ runPeriodicScan cfg state
  logMessage state "Periodic scan started"
  forever $ do
    shutting <- readTVarIO (isShuttingDown state)
    when shutting $ do
      logMessage state "Shutdown complete"
      h <- readMVar (logHandle state)
      hClose h
    threadDelay 1000000
